name: finding
description: Something the programme learned, stated as a claim with the observations it rests on.

aiGuidance.purpose: Holds what the programme discovered separately from what it plans to do about it. A finding is checkable: the claim is in summary, the observations that support it are in evidence, so a later reader can re-run them and see whether it still holds.
aiGuidance.extraction: Create a finding wherever the source asserts that something is the case — a gap, a count, a behaviour, a contradiction. Put the concrete observations in evidence, one per entry, and keep the claim itself in summary.
